battle.name: 匈牙利民族解放戰爭
battle.theater: 匈牙利中部佩奇州一帶
battle.brief: 一八四八年三月起，匈牙利王國的改革議會與哈布斯堡朝廷決裂，四月維也納調來的帝國軍開進佩奇州，戰爭從佩奇打到蒂薩河、打到特梅什堡。卡面雷管步槍在帝國軍中早已是制式裝備，革命軍則靠舊式火繩槍、獵槍與走私的雷管槍拼湊，後來自製的雷管步槍成為守軍的主要火力，差距仍舊出在炮兵與後勤。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 交戰的兩方是匈牙利王國與哈布斯堡王朝的中央軍。匈牙利一方在一八四八年三月革命的推動下成立國民政府，由首任首相貝特菲尼·約瑟夫主持；國會通過「四月法令」後，國語改以匈牙利語為準，軍隊改編為國民軍並新設國防部，議會又以「春季法律」提出進一步的憲制方案。一八四八年五月起，革命政府與維也納朝廷決裂：國會召開十二週會議，試圖以加冕禮解決王位問題，維也納卻在德國與義大利用兵之際另派「匈牙利帝國軍」進軍佩奇州，由陸軍大臣拉圖爾伯爵統籌，拉德茨基元帥與克里米奇、耶拉契奇等將領分道指揮，把佩奇方面與加里西亞的波蘭志願兵視為叛亂而加以鎮壓。匈牙利一方的編制核心是新建的國民軍與義勇兵：貝特菲尼招募的志願者、佩奇的國民警衛隊、科莫拉姆的要塞守軍，以及一八四九年才成形的「洪維德」常備步兵；一八四九年春革命政府頒布徵兵制，名義上可得數十萬人，實際形成戰鬥力的多為各地護國兵與有經驗的舊軍官率領的營連。奧地利一方是帝國中央軍：步兵團與獵兵團、騎兵旅、由維也納兵工廠製造的臼砲與野戰炮，以及後來自俄國的遠征軍，軍制、幹部和後勤都遠勝於革命軍，軍官多為維也納與布拉格軍事學院出身的職業軍人。戰爭的第三階段由俄軍介入，兩股帝國方面的軍隊聯手對付革命軍。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Kingdom of Hungary and the central army of the Habsburg dynasty. On the Hungarian side, the revolution of March 1848 produced a national government under the first prime minister, József Batthyány. After the April laws the Hungarian language became the language of state, the forces were remade as a national army, and a ministry of defence was created; the assembly then set out a further constitutional programme in the Spring Laws. From May 1848 the revolutionary government and the Vienna court broke apart: the Diet sat for twelve weeks and tried to settle the crown question with a coronation, while Vienna, busy in Germany and Italy, sent the Imperial Army into the county of Pest under the minister of war Count Latour, with Field Marshal Radetzky and generals such as Clam-Gallas and Jellacic commanding in the field, and treated the men of Pest and the Polish volunteers from Galicia as rebels. The core of the Hungarian side was the new national army and its volunteers: the men Batthyány enlisted, the civic guard of Pest, the garrison of the fortress of Komárom, and the Honvéd standing infantry that only took shape in 1849. In the spring of 1849 the revolutionary government passed a conscription law that on paper produced hundreds of thousands; the real fighting strength was made up of the local guard battalions and companies led by experienced former officers. The Austrian side was the imperial central army: infantry and hunter regiments, cavalry brigades, mortars and field guns from the Vienna arsenals, and later the Russian expeditionary force. Its organisation, its officer corps and its supply were all far above the revolution's, and its officers were professionals trained at the military academies of Vienna and Prague. A third phase of the war was fought with Russian intervention, the two imperial armies operating together against the revolution.
people: 科蘇什·拉約什是革命的政治領袖，他在三月的演說中提出改革綱領，四月被選為國家的實際領袖，主張匈牙利王國自治、廢除封建壟斷、成立國民軍，他的講詞在佩奇、布拉格與維也納傳開，成為革命的火種。貝特菲尼·約瑟夫出身保守貴族，首任首相，主張以談判與國會立法解決王位問題，四月的妥協方案失敗後辭職，隨後作為特使赴土耳其求援。軍方領袖中，德姆比斯基這位波蘭將軍在一八四九年春的戰役中一度指揮革命軍，高爾蓋自四月起在北部戰線執掌兵權並在最後的失敗中扮演關鍵角色，克林普卡與達姆亞尼奇分率南北兩線，貝姆在特蘭西瓦尼亞以少量兵力拖住俄軍，謝切尼則以「偉人」之名主持國防委員會並在佩奇受傷，次年辭世。佩托菲這位詩人則成為革命的象徵，他在卡波爾瑙一役之後失蹤於戰場。奧地利方面，國王費迪南德一世、帕拉廷親王約瑟夫與施特凡大公主持朝政，總理大臣門斯多夫-普利與拉圖爾伯爵掌握軍政，拉德茨基元帥在義大利作戰後被調回匈牙利戰線，耶拉契奇從巴爾幹召回後鎮壓特蘭西瓦尼亞的起義，海瑙在四九年夏季率軍加入戰局並擔任後方整肅的主導者。俄國方面，尼古拉一世調派帕斯凱維奇元帥率遠征軍越過普魯特河，戰局的轉折點由此出現。
peopleEn: Lajos Kossuth was the political leader of the revolution; his March speeches set out the programme of reform, in April he was chosen as the effective head of the nation, and he argued for an autonomous Hungarian kingdom, the abolition of feudal monopolies and a national army. His words travelled from Pest to Prague and Vienna and set the revolution alight. József Batthyány, of the conservative nobility, was the first prime minister and believed the crown question could be settled by negotiation and legislation; he resigned after the compromise of April failed and went to Turkey as an envoy. Among the commanders, the Polish general Dembiński led the revolutionary army in the spring campaign of 1849; Artúr Görgei took charge of the northern front from April and played the decisive part in the final defeat; György Klapka and János Damjanich commanded the southern and northern lines respectively; József Bem held Russian forces in Transylvania with a handful of men; and István Széchenyi presided over the defence committee and was wounded at Pest before resigning in the following year. The poet Petőfi became the symbol of the revolution and disappeared on the battlefield after the fighting at Kápolna. On the Austrian side the king Ferdinand I, the Palatine Joseph and Archduke Stephen governed, with the minister-president Mensdorff-Pouilly and Count Latour holding the war portfolio; Radetzky was recalled from Italy to the Hungarian theatre; Jellacic was brought back from the Balkans to crush the Transylvanian rising; and Haynau joined the fighting in the summer of 1849 and afterwards directed the liquidation in the interior. On the Russian side Nicholas I sent Field Marshal Paskevich with an expeditionary army across the Prut, and that decision turned the course of the war.
kits: 卡面這件雷管步槍在這場戰爭裡是「軍制差」的近距離寫照。哈布斯堡帝國軍的步兵在一八四〇年代中期已換裝一八四一年式雷管步槍，這種槍帶有雷管擊發機構，槍管可承受較高膛壓，能配刺刀作近戰，並另配短管卡賓槍給獵兵與偵察兵使用；野戰炮以四磅、六磅與十二磅為主，另有大量臼砲，帝國軍的炮兵密度遠高於革命軍。匈牙利革命軍的槍械則是拼湊出來的：一八四八年春的國民軍多由徵召的農民與城市自願者組成，槍械來自守備隊倉庫、修道院沒收的武器與民間獵槍，火繩槍與燧發槍為主，雷管槍只在部分營連中出現；一八四九年春才由佩奇與科莫拉姆的作坊大規模仿製與改裝雷管步槍並從鄰國輸入，這批槍械在北方戰線以洪維德的樣式配發，但槍管與刺刀規格不統一，備件補充困難。炮兵是革命軍最薄弱的一環：初期只有少數野戰炮與大量土製砲，到四八至四九年擴軍之後才勉強湊出與帝國軍對峙的射擊能力，而在佩奇與蒂薩河下游的會戰裡，正是帝國軍的臼砲與野戰炮數量決定了攻守。騎兵方面，革命軍有國民騎兵與志願騎手，裝備以馬刀與獵槍為主，缺少制式卡賓槍與馬匹補充；帝國軍則有完整的輕騎兵旅與騎炮兵。運輸與後勤同樣懸殊：革命軍靠志願運輸隊、徵用農車與臨時浮橋跨越蒂薩河與多瑙河，糧食由沒收的莊園與教會地產支應；帝國軍與俄軍則靠維也納與華沙的軍需系統、鐵路與專用車隊，冬季仍可持續補給。
kitsEn: The percussion rifle on this card is a close-up of the difference in military organisation in this war. The Habsburg infantry had taken up the 1841 pattern percussion musket by the mid-1840s: the primer action was reliable, the barrel stood higher pressures, the weapon took a bayonet for close work, and short carbines were issued to the hunters and scouts. Field guns were mostly four-, six- and twelve-pounders with a large number of mortars, so the density of imperial artillery was far above the revolution's. The Hungarian guns were cobbled together. The national army of the spring of 1848 was recruited from peasants and city volunteers, armed from garrison magazines, from weapons confiscated from monasteries and from private hunting guns: matchlocks and flintlocks predominated, and percussion arms appeared only in a few companies. It was not until the spring of 1849 that the workshops at Pest and Komárom turned out and converted percussion muskets in quantity and that they were bought in from neighbouring states; they were issued on the northern front in the Honvéd pattern, but barrels and bayonets did not match and spare parts were hard to come by. Artillery was the revolution's weakest limb: at first only a few field guns and a great many improvised pieces, and only after the expansion of 1848 and 1849 could it muster enough shooting power to face the imperial guns. It was the number of imperial mortars and field guns that decided the fighting around Pest and on the lower Tisza. In cavalry the revolutionaries had national cavalry and mounted volunteers armed mainly with sabres and hunting guns, without service carbines or a supply of horses; the imperial army had complete dragoon brigades and horse artillery. Supply was just as uneven: the revolutionaries relied on volunteer transport columns, requisitioned farm carts and improvised pontoon bridges over the Tisza and the Danube, and drew food from confiscated estates and church lands; the imperial and Russian armies drew on the commissariat systems of Vienna and Warsaw, on the railways and on dedicated wagon trains, and could keep going through the winter.
tactics: 革命軍的戰術是「以速度與地形換取正面」。《四月法令》之後，國民軍以營為單位迅速編組，強調地方自衛、游擊與襲擊軍需薄弱處；一八四八年四月二十九日佩奇附近的卡波爾瑙一戰，革命軍主動進攻帝國軍右翼，卻因步兵散開過早、缺乏鞏固的射擊線而被反擊擊退，攻守之勢就此逆轉。帝國軍的戰術核心是「炮兵主導的正面突破」：以密集的野戰炮與臼砲先摧毀革命軍的炮兵陣地與縱隊，再以步兵密集縱隊在刺刀距離上解決戰鬥，同時用騎兵旅壓住側翼潰散的散兵。革命軍在失血之後改為集中機動：一八四九年春，克林普卡與達姆亞尼奇等人在蒂薩河與多瑙河之間強行架設浮橋、夜間急行軍插入帝國軍側後，企圖以速度扭轉兵力的差距，其中一八四九年四月的泰特尼一役即以集中炮火與側翼迂迴擊敗帝國軍的追擊縱隊。然而同年六月俄軍越過普魯特河加入戰局之後，局勢驟變：俄軍以巨大縱隊直取佩奇與布達佩斯，革命軍被迫分兵，終在特梅什堡與其後的維拉戈什被合圍。戰役細節上，多瑙河與蒂薩河的渡口、佩奇外圍的塹壕與碉堡群、科莫拉姆要塞的圍城都成為關鍵節點：帝國軍在科莫拉姆圍城中使用重炮與封鎖，把要塞守軍困在城內數月，革命軍的戰略反攻因主力被牽制而落空。
tacticsEn: The revolutionary way of war was to trade space and speed for a frontal battle. After the April laws the national army was organised quickly at company level, emphasising local defence, harassment and attacks on the enemy's thin supply points. At the battle of Kápolna near Pest on 29 April 1848 the revolutionaries attacked the imperial right, but their infantry had dispersed too early and had no solid line of fire, so the counter-stroke turned the battle and with it the whole initiative. The core of the imperial method was the artillery-led frontal breakthrough: massed field guns and mortars first destroyed the revolutionary batteries and columns, the infantry then closed to the bayonet distance, and the cavalry brigades rode down the flanks and the broken men. After bleeding, the revolution switched to concentrated manoeuvre: in the spring of 1849 Klapka and Damjanich forced pontoon bridges over the Tisza and the Danube and marched by night to fall on the imperial rear, trying to use speed to cancel the difference in numbers, and at Tétény in April 1849 massed artillery and a flanking turn broke the imperial pursuing column. Then in June 1849 the Russians crossed the Prut and everything changed: their huge columns drove straight at Pest and Buda, the revolutionaries were forced to split, and they were finally enveloped at Temesvár and after it at Vágúshely. In detail, the crossings of the Danube and the Tisza, the entrenchments and redoubts outside Pest, and the siege of the fortress of Komárom were the decisive points. The imperial artillery at Komárom used heavy guns and blockade lines to hold the garrison inside its walls for months, and the revolutionary counter-stroke died because its main effort was tied down there.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下：戰爭自一八四八年三月革命、四月起兵，至一八四九年八月十三日維拉戈什投降，前後約十七個月。一八四八年秋革命軍在佩奇周圍集結的兵力約三萬至四萬人，帝國軍在佩奇方向約一萬二千至一萬五千人；一八四九年春以徵兵制組成的軍隊名冊可達二三十萬人，實際可用兵力約十四萬至二十萬人，其中洪維德常備兵約七萬至八萬人；同期奧地利帝國軍在匈牙利方向集結約九萬至十萬人，俄軍在一八四九年夏季投入約十五萬至二十萬人，俄方公布的數字遠高於此。炮兵方面，帝國軍在科莫拉姆圍城集結數十門重炮與臼砲，革命軍在維拉戈什投降時可用的野戰炮僅數十門。距離方面，從佩奇到布達佩斯約二百公里，帝國軍自維也納與布拉格向佩奇行軍約三百至三百五十公里，一八四九年六月俄軍自普魯特河畔向佩奇推進約二百五十公里。損失方面，一八四八年四月的卡波爾瑙一役，革命軍陣亡與重傷合計約三千至四千人，帝國軍的損失約一千至一千五百人。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The war ran from the revolution of March 1848 and the first shots in April to the surrender at Vágúshely on 13 August 1849, about seventeen months. In the autumn of 1848 the revolutionaries had gathered some thirty to forty thousand men around Pest against twelve to fifteen thousand imperial troops in the same sector. Under the conscription law of spring 1849 the rolls of the revolutionary army reached two or three hundred thousand names, while the usable force was perhaps fourteen to twenty thousand men, of whom the standing Honvéd accounted for seventy to eighty thousand. At the same time the Austrian imperial army concentrated in Hungary numbered about ninety to one hundred thousand men, and the Russians put fifteen to twenty thousand into the fighting in the summer of 1849, with Russian figures published much higher. In artillery the imperial side brought dozens of heavy guns and mortars against the siege of Komárom, while at the surrender at Vágúshely the revolutionaries had only a few dozen field guns serviceable. In distance, it is about two hundred kilometres from Pest to Buda, the imperial armies marched three hundred to three hundred and fifty kilometres from Vienna and Prague towards Pest, and in June 1849 the Russian columns advanced about two hundred and fifty kilometres from the Prut to the neighbourhood of Pest. In losses, at Kápolna in April 1848 the revolutionaries counted about three to four thousand dead and wounded against roughly one thousand to one thousand five hundred for the imperial side.
cause: 起因有遠因與近因。遠因是哈布斯堡帝國在維也納會議之後的保守體制：一八一五年以後的奧地利維持以天主教王權為核心的中歐邦聯君主國，壓制國家的憲制要求；匈牙利王國雖保有自身的法規與代議制度，卻沒有日後奧地利二元帝國那樣的自治地位，而梅特涅時代的警察制度、關稅與財政改革進一步壓縮了匈牙利貴族與新興市民的空間。近因是一八四八年三月歐洲革命的連鎖反應：巴黎二月革命、維也納三月革命推翻梅特涅，革命浪潮掃到佩奇；匈牙利國會在三月召開，迅速通過「四月法令」，廢除封建壟斷、承認匈牙利語為國語、建立國民軍與國防部，王位問題隨即成為導火線——奧地利朝廷既不肯放棄對匈牙利王冠的實際控制，也不接受佩奇方面的憲制方案，遂以協助平叛為名出兵匈牙利，把加里西亞的波蘭志願兵與佩奇的國民軍視為叛亂而加以鎮壓。直接點火的是一八四八年五月維也納朝廷解散匈牙利國會、另立由奧地利人組成的國民軍，並把耶拉契奇從巴爾幹召回鎮壓德涅爾河與特蘭西瓦尼亞的起義；匈牙利議會隨即宣布廢止哈布斯堡王朝在匈牙利的統治，衝突由憲制爭議升級為內戰。
causeEn: The cause had a remote and an immediate side. The remote cause was the conservative structure the Habsburg empire had kept since the Congress of Vienna: after 1815 Austria presided over a central European composite monarchy built around Catholic kingship and suppressed demands for constitutional government. The Kingdom of Hungary kept its own statutes and representative institutions but never enjoyed the autonomy the Austrian dual monarchy would later grant, and Metternich's police system, customs policy and financial reforms narrowed further the space of the Hungarian nobility and the rising towns. The immediate cause was the chain reaction of the revolutions of 1848: the February revolution in Paris, the March revolution in Vienna that brought down Metternich, and the wave running on into Pest. The Hungarian Diet met in March, passed the April laws quickly, abolished the feudal monopolies, made Hungarian the language of state and created a national army and a ministry of war, and the question of the crown became the fuse. The Vienna court would neither surrender effective control of the Hungarian crown nor accept the constitutional programme from Pest, so it sent troops into Hungary in the name of suppressing a revolt, treating the Polish volunteers from Galicia and the men of Pest as rebels. What actually lit the fuse in May 1848 was the dissolution of the Hungarian Diet, the setting up of a new national army officered by Austrians, and the recall of Jellacic from the Balkans to put down the rising on the Danube and in Transylvania; the Diet then declared the rule of the Habsburg dynasty over Hungary at an end, and a constitutional quarrel became a civil war.
impact: 影響不僅在匈牙利內部。憲制上，革命政府的「春季法律」提出匈地利王國與奧地利共享的二元帝國方案、常備軍、選舉改革與土地改革，雖隨失敗而未落實，卻成為奧地利憲制演變的藍本，一八六七年《二月條約》確立的奧匈二元帝國在結構上正是這份未竟方案的回應。國際上，革命把「民族自決」與武裝起義的語彙帶入中歐；俄軍的干預則樹立了「以武力維持維也納體系」的先例，此後克里米亞戰爭的介入邏輯與十九世紀末瓜分東歐的邏輯，都可以從一八四九年的干預中找到雛形。族群與教派上，匈牙利少數民族在革命期間被指為「反基督者」，戰後的清算、監禁與流放造成社會的長期裂痕，被壓迫者的民族主義成為一八六七年以後的道德資源。軍隊上，革命軍雖敗，卻建立了「洪維德」的傳統與一套現代化步兵的經驗，其幹部成為一八六七年之後匈牙利軍與奧匈帝國陸軍的骨幹；湧現的將領如高爾蓋、克林普卡與貝姆，先後在土耳其與皮埃蒙特的軍中服務，把匈牙利革命的戰鬥經驗帶到更遠的戰場。思想上，這場革命是「改革民族主義」的樣本：它把土地改革、兵役制度與語言政策綁在一起，此後在歐洲各地的民族運動中被援引為先例，也讓帝國政府明白，壓制民族要求必須以更強的軍隊與更徹底的行政改造為代價。
impactEn: The consequences reached beyond Hungary itself. In constitutional terms the Spring Laws of the revolutionary government set out a scheme for a dual monarchy shared by the Kingdom of Hungary and Austria, together with a standing army, electoral reform and land reform; although it fell with the revolution, it became the blueprint for the constitutional evolution of Austria, and the Austro-Hungarian dual monarchy established by the February Decree of 1867 was in structural terms the response to that unfinished scheme. Internationally the revolution carried the vocabulary of national self-determination and armed insurrection into central Europe, while the Russian intervention set a precedent for the maintenance of the Vienna system by force, a logic whose descendants can be traced in the interventionism of the Crimean War and in the partition of eastern Europe at the end of the century. In ethnic and religious terms the minority nationalities of Hungary were branded during the revolution as enemies of Christ, and the liquidation, imprisonment and exile that followed left a long wound in society, with the nationalism of the persecuted becoming a moral resource after 1867. Militarily the revolution lost, but it established the Honvéd tradition and the experience of a modern infantry, and its cadre became the backbone of the Hungarian army and of the Austro-Hungarian army after 1867; the commanders it produced, Görgei, Klapka and Bem, went on to serve in the armies of Turkey and Piedmont, carrying the fighting experience of the Hungarian revolution to distant battlefields. In thought the revolt was a model of reforming nationalism: it tied land reform, military service and language policy together and was cited afterwards as a precedent by national movements across Europe, while teaching the imperial governments that the suppression of national claims had to be paid for with stronger armies and a more thorough reconstruction of the administration.
result: 結果是革命軍在中央與南方戰線相持一年之後崩潰。一八四八年四月的卡波爾瑙之役是關鍵轉折，帝國軍守住陣地之後，革命軍轉為守勢，其後維也納方面的重炮與冬天的到來，使佩奇一線的攻勢最終無功。一八四九年春的「春季戰役」中，革命軍一度靠集中兵力與側翼機動取得局部戰果，卻無法扭轉整體劣勢；六月俄軍越過普魯特河、與帝國軍會合之後，戰局迅速崩壞，革命軍放棄佩奇與布達佩斯，向特梅什堡方向退卻，八月十一日在特梅什堡一戰全軍覆沒，八月十三日高爾蓋在維拉戈什率約一萬五千人無條件投降，科蘇什隨後流亡土耳其，主要領袖被審訊、判刑與流放，匈牙利進入維也納的「新絕對主義」時期，司法與行政改革被全面逆轉。戰役層面的結算是：革命軍的戰術偏向游擊與地方自衛，缺少能與帝國軍炮兵對抗的火力，最終靠不住；帝國軍的勝利則建立在制式槍械、壓倒性的炮兵與可以越冬的後勤之上，而革命軍最可貴的資產——洪維德的組織與骨幹——在投降之後被拆散，卻也隨之流散到土耳其與義大利的戰場上。
resultEn: The result was that the revolutionary army collapsed after holding the central and southern fronts for a year. The battle of Kápolna in April 1848 was the turning point: once the imperial army held its ground, the revolution went on the defensive, and the heavy guns from Vienna together with the arrival of winter made the offensive around Pest fail. In the spring campaign of 1849 the revolutionaries won local results by concentration and flanking movement, but could not reverse the overall disadvantage; in June the Russians crossed the Prut and joined the imperial armies, and the situation collapsed at once. The revolutionaries gave up Pest and Buda and fell back towards Temesvár, where on 11 August their army was destroyed in the final battle, and on 13 August Görgei surrendered unconditionally at Vágúshely with about fifteen thousand men. Kossuth fled to Turkey, the principal leaders were tried, sentenced and exiled, and Hungary entered the neo-absolutist period under Vienna with its judicial and administrative reforms reversed. The tactical settlement runs like this: the revolutionaries fought in the manner of harassment and local defence and never had the firepower to stand up to the imperial artillery, and the imperial victory rested on service muskets, overwhelming artillery and a supply system that could get through the winter, while the revolution's most valuable asset, the organisation and cadre of the Honvéd, was broken up at the surrender and scattered in turn to the battlefields of Turkey and Italy.
